commit.message:
LU-18857 tests: skip conf-sanity/157,161,164 in interop

Skip conf-sanity.sh test_157a, test_157b, test_161 in interop testing
with old servers because they test new features that old servers lack.

Improve the version checking and skip message for nearby subtests.
